novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a mechanism/measurement hypothesis: sandbagging leaves “the correct answer ... represented internally even as it is suppressed at the output,” with a proposed distinction between “late-layer gating vs early miscomputation.” Searches around “sandbagging hidden capability activation probes correct answer,” “password-locked models internal representations logit lens,” and “strategic deception linear probes” identify van der Weij et al., AI Sandbagging (2024), Stress-Testing Capability Elicitation With Password-Locked Models (2024), Noise Injection Reveals Hidden Capabilities of Sandbagging Language Models (2024), and the closely related knowledge–action-gap study Interpretability without actionability (2026). Moving from those works to layerwise probing of sandbagging is a natural but non-trivial extension: internal representations outperforming outputs is already known, but relating suppression depth and signal recoverability to the strength and type of sandbagging adds a specific mechanistic relationship rather than merely renaming a standard probe.
